metadata.description: Skills for running an autonomous, register-driven software build with Claude Code.

plugins.name: software-factory
plugins.description: Prime a project for an unattended build, check its environment before it starts, generate the wave-based build loop, and run a monitor seat with a live progress checklist.

plugins.name: factory-live
plugins.description: Early access. The build seat, live inside Claude Code: wakes a seat paused on a usage limit once the window resets, writes the rate-limit windows and every turn's tokens beside the keep-alive's state, and shows the keep-alive's counts above the prompt.
